title: Stock Market Today Live: Rupee closes Wednesday's session at 7-month high of 93.69 as FPI inflows, lower crude prices boost sentiment - The HinduBusinessLine
text:

Buoyed by robust FPI inflows into the equity markets and a decline in crude oil prices, the Rupee closed Wednesday near a seven-month high.

The rupee gains 24 paise to 93.69 against the dollar on FPI inflows and lower crude prices, while Axis Bank retains its ₹100 target for June 2027.
